subject: math
topicName: College Review Week 2: Percent Change, Discounts, and Mixtures
description: Strengthen percent increase, decrease, discount, markup, and mixture reasoning by tracking what quantity each percent is based on.
learningObjectives: Solve percent increase and decrease problems without treating them as simple subtraction
Track changing bases in discounts, markups, and repeated percent change
Model mixture problems using part-plus-part-equals-total structure
Avoid common traps where the 'whole' changes between steps
